description: Go beyond Virgin Islands National Park's stunning white-sand beaches. Hike to historic plantation sites to learn about a challenging past when sugar and enslaved labor dominated life on the island.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Virgin Islands National Park, Virgin Islands

title: Vietnam Veterans Memorial
description: Honoring the men and women who served in the controversial Vietnam War, the Vietnam Veterans Memorial chronologically lists the names of 58,318 Americans who gave their lives in service to their country.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Vietnam Veterans Memorial, District of Columbia (dedicated 1982)

title: Voyageurs National Park
description: Voyageurs National Park spans 218,000 acres of lakes, forests, and streams in northern Minnesota. Established in 1975, the park is named after the French-Canadian Voyageurs who once navigated these abundant waters.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Voyageurs National Park, Minnesota

title: Washita Battlefield National Historic Site
description: On November 27, 1868, Lt. Colonel George Armstrong Custer led the 7th US Cavalry on a surprise dawn attack on a Cheyenne village led by Peace Chief Black Kettle.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Washita Battlefield National Historic Site, Oklahoma

title: Walnut Canyon National Monument
description: Since time immemorial, Indigenous Peoples have lived and traveled throughout Walnut Canyon’s dynamic landscape. Vibrant communities built their homes in the cliffs and farmed along the canyon’s rim.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Walnut Canyon National Monument, Arizona

title: Waco Mammoth National Monument
description: Standing as tall as 14 feet and weighing 20,000 pounds, Columbian mammoths roamed across what is present-day Texas thousands of years ago. Today, the fossil specimens represent the nation's first and only recorded evidence of a nursery herd of ice age Columbian mammoths.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Waco Mammoth National Monument, Texas

title: Washington Monument
description: Built to honor George Washington, the United States' first president, the 555-foot marble obelisk towers over Washington, D.C.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Washington Monument, District of Columbia (accepted; dedicated in1885)

title: War in the Pacific National Historical Park
description: War in the Pacific National Historical Park was established to commemorate the bravery and sacrifice of those participating in the campaigns of the Pacific Theater of World War II and to conserve and interpret outstanding natural, scenic, and historic values and objects of the island of Guam.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: War in the Pacific National Historical Park, Guam

title: Weir Farm National Historical Park
description: Visit the home and studio of America's most beloved Impressionist, J. Alden Weir, and walk in the footsteps of generations of world-class artists.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Weir Farm National Historical Park, Connecticut (redesignated from Weir Farm National Historic Site in 2021)

title: White House
description: The White House is owned by the American people and stewarded by the National Park Service. It is more than the President's residence; it is a site for protests and national discourse about what it means to be American.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: The White House and President's Park, District of Columbia (transferred to the National Park Service on August 10, 1933)

title: Whiskeytown-Shasta-Trinity National Recreation Area
description: Whiskeytown Lake’s crystal-clear waters are iconic, but this 42,000-acre National Recreation Area offers much more. Explore waterfalls, hike rugged trails, uncover Gold Rush history, and witness the resilience of nature in its post-fire recovery.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Whiskeytown-Shasta-Trinity National Recreation Area, California (Whiskeytown Unit)

title: Whitman Mission National Historic Site
description: One moment can change the fate of many nations. After thousands of years of habitation by the Cayuse Nation, life in the Columbia River Plateau begins to change rapidly with the influx of missionaries, newcomers from the Oregon Trail, and diseases.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Whitman Mission National Historic Site, Washington (redesignated from Whitman National Monument 1963)

title: White Sands National Park
description: Rising from the heart of the Tularosa Basin is one of the world's great natural wonders - the glistening white sands of New Mexico. Great wave-like dunes of gypsum sand have engulfed 275 square miles of desert, creating the world's largest gypsum dunefield.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: White Sands National Park, New Mexico (redesignated from White Sands National Monument 2019)

title: Wind Cave National Park
description: Wind Cave National Park protects two very different worlds - one deep within the earth, the other a sunlit world of many resources. Bison, elk, and other wildlife roam the rolling prairie grasslands and forested hillsides of one of America's oldest national parks.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Wind Cave National Park, South Dakota

title: President William Jefferson Clinton Birthplace Home National Historic Site
description: Named for the father who died shortly before his birth, William Jefferson Blythe III later became the 42nd President of the United States. In Hope, the experiences shared with his mother and grandparents in rural Arkansas developed the broad views on race relations, social justice, and public service that defined his presidency and life after the White House.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: President William Jefferson Clinton Birthplace Home National Historic Site, Arkansas

title: Wilson's Creek National Battlefield
description: Wilson's Creek was the first major Civil War battle fought west of the Mississippi River, and where the first Union general was killed in action. The costly Southern victory on August 10, 1861, focused national attention on the war in Missouri.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Wilson's Creek National Battlefield, Missouri (redesignated from a National Park 1970)

title: William Howard Taft National Historic Site
description: High atop one of Cincinnati's most prominent hilltops stands the two-story Greek Revival house where William Howard Taft was born and grew up. Hard work, a good education, and an interest in civic duty are attributes that made the Taft family outstanding leaders over the years.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: William Howard Taft National Historic Site, Ohio

title: Women's Rights National Historical Park
description: Women’s Rights National Historical Park tells the story of the first Women’s Rights Convention, held in Seneca Falls, New York on July 19-20, 1848. It is a story of struggles for civil rights, human rights, and equality, global struggles that continue today.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Women's Rights National Historical Park, New York

title: Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts
description: No matter what your age or taste in shows, you'll find something you like onstage at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts. From May through September, multiple amphitheaters in the park present performances such as musicals, dance, opera, jazz, and popular and country music.

title: Wright Brothers National Memorial
description: Wright Brothers National Memorial commemorates Wilbur and Orville Wright’s first successful airplane flights on December 17, 1903, following four years of experiments at Kitty Hawk.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Wright Brothers National Memorial, North Carolina (originally Kill Devil Hill Monument, redesignated 1953)

title: Wrangell-St. Elias National Park
description: Wrangell-St. Elias is a vast national park that rises from the ocean all the way up to 18,008 ft.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Wrangell-St. Elias National Park and Wrangell-St. Elias National Preserve, Alaska (incorporated Wrangell-St. Elias National Monument by ANILCA 1980)

title: Wupatki National Monument
description: Nestled between the Painted Desert and ponderosa highlands of northern Arizona, Wupatki National Monument is an unlikely landscape for a thriving community. The early 1100's marked a time of cooler and wetter weather, when the ancestors of contemporary Pueblo communities created a bustling center of trade and culture.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Wupatki National Monument, Arizona

title: World War II Memorial
description: Through stone architecture and bronze sculptures, the World War II Memorial recognizes the ways Americans served, honors those who fell, and recognizes the victory they achieved to restore freedom and end tyranny around the globe.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: World War II Memorial, District of Columbia (authorized May 25, 1993)

title: World War I Memorial
description: A grateful nation honors the service, valor, courage and sacrifice of the 4.7 million American sons and daughters who served in the Great War.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: World War I Memorial, District of Columbia

title: Yellowstone National Park
description: On March 1, 1872, Yellowstone became the first national park for all to enjoy the unique hydrothermal wonders. Today, millions of people come here each year to camp, hike, and enjoy the majesty of the park.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Yellowstone National Park, Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming

title: Yosemite National Park
description: Not just a great valley, but a shrine to human foresight, the strength of granite, the power of glaciers, the persistence of life, and the tranquility of the High Sierra.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Yosemite National Park, California (incorporated Yosemite State Park in 1906)

title: Yukon-Charley Rivers National Preserve
description: Located in Interior Alaska, Yukon-Charley Rivers offers exploration in a largely untouched landscape. Whether you float the mighty Yukon River or paddle the Charley River's whitewater, your memories will last a lifetime.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Yukon-Charley Rivers National Preserve, Alaska (redesignated from Yukon-Charley National Monument by ANILCA 1980)

title: Yucca House National Monument
description: Yucca House National Monument preserves a large unexcavated pueblo with a stunning setting in Montezuma Valley, nestled between Mesa Verde and Ute Mountain. Since Yucca House was protected as a national monument in 1919, it has remained largely untouched, offering intrepid visitors a sense of discovery and preserving the pueblo's beauty and integrity for future generations.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Yucca House National Monument, Colorado

title: Zion National Park
description: Follow the paths where people have walked for thousands of years. Gaze up at massive sandstone cliffs of cream, pink, and red that soar into a brilliant blue sky.

established.label: NPS park anniversaries · original establishment / authorization
established.note: Zion National Park, Utah (incorporated Zion National Monument in 1956; incorporated Mukuntuweap National Monument in 1918)
